ops.title: Second servable watcher base (mlx-lm-loadable LoRA for a non-8B Qwen)
ops.description: Unblocks cc-steer's deferred C4 base-model sweep (decision noted in cc-steer's ledger 2026-07-17). athome 0.7.0 BASE_MODELS: qwen3.5-4b and qwen3.5-9b are serves_locally=False because their LoRA cannot load into mlx-lm; only qwen3-8b trains+serves+scores through the served-MLX instrument. Either make one of the 3.5-generation adapters servable (mlx-lm support or a conversion path) or add a different servable base. cc-steer's sweep machinery is already arm-parameterized on serves_locally — it activates with no code change once a second arm exists.

ops.text: a second BASE_MODELS entry with serves_locally=True, proven by a real materialize→serve→score smoke
